purpose: ADR-135/137/138 closeout item 6 — drive /health and a chat request against a locally-run facade through a real browser, and check that every surface names ONE serving identity.

driver.tool: chrome-devtools-mcp on the browsercontainer sidecar (MCP SSE http://browsercontainer:8931/sse)
driver.method: page-context fetch() from a real Chrome tab opened at http://agentbox:8123/health
driver.why_not_curl: curl was also run (see local-facade-receipt.json); the browser leg additionally proves the surfaces answer a real cross-origin-capable HTTP client from another container, not just a loopback client on the same host.

target.process: loom-facade (debug) run in the agentbox container, NOT the HP production facade
target.production_facade_untouched: http://192.168.2.132:8084 was read only (GET /health) and never redeployed or mutated

data.source: tests/golden-python/fixture.json + fixture-prose.json, promoted with a real .generation.json commit marker

rejections: artefact declares no embedding model; contract requires "bge-small-en-v1.5"

chat.request: POST /v1/chat/completions {"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Explain how a knowledge graph uses a graph database"}]}
chat.content_head: _Served verbatim from the Ontology Loom (generation: 2026-09-05T09:00:00Z); no model generation was performed._

identity_agreement.note: ADR-135's acceptance condition asked to 'compare scaffold, graph and chat generation fields'. All three name the same LOADED bundle, and the content digest — not just the generation string — matches, which is the discriminator generation equality alone could not provide.

observations: The phase advanced Activated -> Served across the session, so 'a bundle is loaded' and 'a bundle has answered' are separately reportable, as the review required.
verify_atomicity ran on the serving path (drift.checked = true) rather than existing as an uninvoked method.

The real exported artefact data/ontology-corpus.rvdb FAILS the new strict contract because its sidecar declares no embeddingModel. This is a genuine finding, not a test artefact: model identity was previously unverifiable, and semantic readiness now says so. Remediation is for the exporter to stamp embeddingModel/dimensions into <artifact>.generation.json; LOOM_SEMANTIC_REQUIRE_MODEL_ID=0 is the documented escape hatch for a knowingly pre-contract artefact. Semantic fallback is default-off, so no deployment behaviour changes today.
